tools.description: Get a complete snapshot of your AgentPhone account: agents, phone numbers, webhook status, and usage limits. Call this first to orient yourself before using other tools.
tools.name: account_overview

tools.description: Attach a phone number to an agent so the agent handles calls/SMS on that number. Use list_numbers to find unassigned number IDs and list_agents for agent IDs.

number_id.description: The phone number ID to attach

tools.name: attach_number

tools.description: Purchase a new phone number. Use area_code to request a specific region (e.g. '415' for San Francisco). Tip: pass agent_id to attach it immediately, or use attach_number later.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to attach this number to immediately

area_code.description: 3-digit area code for a specific region (e.g. '415', '212', '310')

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. US, CA, GB)

tools.name: buy_number

tools.description:
Create a new agent. An agent owns phone numbers and handles calls/SMS.

After creating, use buy_number or attach_number to give it a phone number.
Set voice_mode to 'hosted' with a system_prompt for autonomous AI voice calls, or 'webhook' (default) to forward call transcripts to your webhook URL.
Use list_voices to see available voice options.

begin_message.description: What the AI says when a call connects. Only used in 'hosted' mode.

description.description: Description of what this agent does

name.description: Name for the agent (e.g. 'Customer Support', 'Sales Bot')

system_prompt.description: Required when voice_mode is 'hosted'. The AI's personality and instructions for voice calls.

transfer_number.description: Phone number to transfer calls to (E.164 format). Enables call transfer during conversations.

voice.description: Voice ID for the agent (use list_voices to see options). Defaults to '11labs-Brian'.

voice_mode.description: 'webhook' (default) forwards transcripts to your webhook. 'hosted' uses built-in AI with system_prompt.

voicemail_message.description: Voicemail greeting text. When set, unanswered calls hear this message and can leave a voicemail.

tools.name: create_agent

tools.description:
Delete an agent permanently. Phone numbers attached to it will be kept but unassigned.

DO NOT USE without confirming with the user — this cannot be undone.
tools.name: delete_agent

tools.description:
Remove a webhook. Pass agent_id to remove an agent's webhook (falls back to project default). Omit agent_id to remove the project-level webhook.

DO NOT USE without confirming with the user.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to delete that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level.

tools.name: delete_webhook

tools.description: Detach a phone number from an agent. The number is kept in your account but becomes unassigned. Use list_agents or get_agent to see which numbers are attached.

agent_id.description: The agent ID that currently owns the number

number_id.description: The phone number ID to detach

tools.name: detach_number

tools.description: Get details for a specific agent including its phone numbers, voice configuration, and system prompt.
tools.name: get_agent

tools.description: Get details and transcript for a specific call. Use list_calls to find call IDs. Pass wait=true to block until an in-progress call finishes before returning.

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait when wait=true. Defaults to 120.

wait.description: When true, long-polls until the call completes before returning. Useful for checking back on a call you initiated earlier.

tools.name: get_call

tools.description: Get a specific SMS conversation with message history. Use list_conversations to find IDs.
tools.name: get_conversation

tools.description: Get SMS messages for a specific phone number. Use list_numbers to find the number ID. For threaded conversations, use list_conversations + get_conversation instead.

number_id.description: The ID of the phone number

tools.name: get_messages

tools.description: Get account usage statistics. By default returns a summary with plan limits, quotas, and message/call volume. Use breakdown='daily' or 'monthly' for time-series data.

breakdown.description: 'summary' for plan limits and totals, 'daily' for per-day breakdown, 'monthly' for per-month breakdown

days.description: Number of days to look back (only used with breakdown='daily')

months.description: Number of months to look back (only used with breakdown='monthly')

tools.name: get_usage

tools.description: Get the webhook configuration. Pass agent_id to get an agent-specific webhook, or omit for the project-level default.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to get that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level webhook.

tools.name: get_webhook

tools.description: List all agents with their phone numbers and voice configuration. An agent is required before you can make calls — it owns phone numbers and handles voice/SMS.
tools.name: list_agents

tools.description:
List recent calls. Scope by agent_id or number_id, or use status/direction/search to filter globally.

When agent_id or number_id is passed, status/direction/search filters are not applied.
Returns call IDs — use get_call with an ID to fetch the full transcript.

agent_id.description: Filter to calls for a specific agent

number_id.description: Filter to calls for a specific phone number

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination)

search.description: Search by phone number or keyword

status.description: Filter by status: ringing, in-progress, completed, failed, busy, no-answer

tools.name: list_calls

tools.description:
List SMS conversations. Optionally filter by agent_id to see conversations for a specific agent.

Each conversation is a thread between your number and an external contact. Use get_conversation with the ID to read messages.

agent_id.description: Filter to conversations for a specific agent

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination)

tools.name: list_conversations

tools.description: List all phone numbers in your account. Each number has an ID needed by other tools (get_messages, attach_number, list_calls).
tools.name: list_numbers

tools.description: List available voices for agents. Use the voice_id value when calling create_agent or update_agent.
tools.name: list_voices

tools.description:
View recent webhook delivery history. Shows which events were delivered, HTTP status codes, and timing.

Pass agent_id to see deliveries for that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to see deliveries for that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level.

hours.description: Only show deliveries from the last N hours

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries

tools.description:
Initiate an outbound phone call.

USE THIS TOOL WHEN the user wants to place a webhook-driven call where your backend handles the conversation logic.
DO NOT USE when the user wants an autonomous AI conversation — use make_conversation_call instead.

The agent must have a phone number attached and a webhook configured (set_webhook).

agent_id.description: The agent ID (must have a phone number attached — use list_agents to check)

from_number_id.description: Specific phone number ID to call from (if agent has multiple numbers)

initial_greeting.description: What the agent says when the call connects

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234)

voice.description: Voice ID override for this call (use list_voices to see options)

tools.name: make_call

tools.description:
Place a phone call where the AI has an autonomous conversation about a given topic.

USE THIS TOOL WHEN the user wants an AI agent to call someone and have a conversation — scheduling, surveys, follow-ups, etc. No webhook setup needed.
DO NOT USE when the user wants a webhook-driven call (use make_call instead).

The agent must have a phone number attached. Use list_agents to check.
By default this blocks until the call finishes and returns the full transcript. Set wait=false for fire-and-forget.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (must have a phone number attached)

from_number_id.description: Specific phone number ID to call from (if agent has multiple numbers)

initial_greeting.description: What the AI says when the call connects. If not set, the AI will generate one from the topic.

max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the call to complete. Defaults to 300 (5 minutes).

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234)

topic.description: The conversation topic or instructions. This becomes the AI's system prompt. Be specific about what the AI should discuss, its personality, and any goals.

voice.description: Voice ID override for this call (use list_voices to see options)

wait.description: When true (default), blocks until the call ends and returns the full transcript.

tools.name: make_conversation_call

tools.description:
Send an SMS or iMessage from one of your agent's phone numbers.

USE THIS TOOL WHEN the user wants to text someone.
The agent must have at least one phone number attached. If the agent has multiple numbers, use number_id to specify which one to send from.

agent_id.description: The agent ID (must have a phone number attached — use list_agents to check)

media_url.description: URL of an image or media file to attach (MMS)

number_id.description: Specific phone number ID to send from (if agent has multiple numbers)

to_number.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234)

tools.name: send_message

tools.description:
Set a webhook URL to receive inbound messages and call events.

Pass agent_id to set a webhook for a specific agent (overrides project default). Omit agent_id to set the project-level webhook for all agents.
The webhook secret is returned — use it to verify signatures.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to set webhook for that agent only. Omit for project-level.

context_limit.description: Number of recent messages to include as conversation context (0-50)

url.description: The publicly accessible webhook URL (must be HTTPS in production)

tools.name: set_webhook

tools.description:
Send a test event to verify a webhook is working. Returns the HTTP status code and response time.

Pass agent_id to test that agent's webhook. Omit to test the project-level webhook.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to test that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level.

tools.name: test_webhook

tools.description:
Update an agent's configuration — name, description, voice settings, system prompt, greeting, call transfer, or voicemail. Only provided fields are updated.
Use list_voices to see available voice IDs. Switching voice_mode to 'hosted' requires a system_prompt.

begin_message.description: What the AI says when a call connects (hosted mode only).

system_prompt.description: The AI's personality and instructions. Required when voice_mode is 'hosted'.

transfer_number.description: Phone number to transfer calls to (E.164 format), or empty string to remove.

voice.description: Voice ID (use list_voices to see options).

voice_mode.description: 'webhook' forwards transcripts to your webhook. 'hosted' uses built-in AI with system_prompt.

voicemail_message.description: Voicemail greeting text, or empty string to disable voicemail.

tools.name: update_agent

tools.description: Set metadata on a conversation. Use this to store custom state, tags, or context that persists between messages. Pass null to clear metadata.

metadata.description: JSON metadata object to store on the conversation, or null to clear

tools.name: update_conversation
